.ordination.scatter

Source: R/internal_functions.R
dot-ordination.scatter.Rd

Internal. Builds the scatter plot of two ordination axes. This is the shared body of plot.PC.scatter and plot.PCoA.scatter.

.ordination.scatter(
  coordinates,
  importance,
  axis.prefix,
  axis.x,
  axis.y,
  color.column = "column.id",
  shape.column = NULL,
  label.column = NULL,
  plot.zero.line.x = TRUE,
  plot.zero.line.y = TRUE,
  positive.axis = NULL,
  point.size = 3,
  extra.layers = NULL
)

Arguments

coordinates

data.frame combining the ordination coordinates and the metadata.

importance

importance/summary table of the ordination.

axis.prefix

String indicating the prefix of the coordinate columns ('PC' or 'PCo').

axis.x

Number of the axis to display on the x-axis.

axis.y

Number of the axis to display on the y-axis.

color.column

String indicating the name of the column to use as factor for the dot colors.

shape.column

String indicating the name of the column to use as factor for the dot shapes.

label.column

String indicating the name of the column to use as label of the dots.

plot.zero.line.x

Logical value indicating whether to plot a gray dashed line at x=0.

plot.zero.line.y

Logical value indicating whether to plot a gray dashed line at y=0.

positive.axis

Logical vector indicating which axes correspond to a positive eigenvalue, or NULL.

point.size

Numeric value indicating the size of the dots.

extra.layers

List of additional ggplot layers to be inserted between the zero-lines and the points (e.g. the loading arrows of a biplot). Default: NULL.

Value

A ggplot object.
